newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says eyeing Mitsubishi motor.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says eyeing Mitsubishi motor.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Friday it was considering the possibility of using a new fuel-efficient engine developed by Mitsubishi Motor Corp in its S40/V40 model.
"Volvo is currently discussing the possibility of purchasing GDI (Gasoline Direct Injection) engines," Volvo Car spokesman Ulf Thorne told Reuters.

Mitsubishi Motor Corp plans to introduce the GDI engine which it says could boost a car's gasoline consumption by up to 20 percent in its new "Galant" model, scheduled to be launched in Japan later this year.
Talks were still in very early stages, Thorne said.

"We have well-functioning cooperation with Mitsubishi Motors today and the production plant of Nedcar in Holland and we are most optimistic when it comes to future discussions in this matter," Thorne said.
"We hope this good relationship with Mitsubishi will give us the opportunity to use this technique in the future," he added.
